content: Ntsüül a nsaŋ a Nzam

Abun, ngye, ngye un'lɔɔn bàsawɛɛl anki, ngye, itàkal naa ngye awà nà, ngye mbuur afàtsul mbar. Ntɔn, afàtsul ngye mbar a mbuur asin, ngye awàŋàkwɛlà ngye ŋakwo, ntɔn ngye afàkyer abun, ngye mbuur afàtsul mbar.
Kyekà, bi ikyàyöb naa ntsüül a nsaŋ a Nzam ifàkal unsà ndandaa ifàpà ngö akà baar bàfàkyer indiir abin.
Nkye ngye akasii, ngye mbuur afàtsul nsaŋ a baar ban'kyer anà afàkyer asànaa ba, naa ngye ayàkwɛlà anki u ntsüül a nsaŋ a Nzam?
Taaŋ lumwɛy ngye awàmudyà un'siinà un'naaŋ a ubwaŋ ande, nkääŋ a mpem anà un'kaay ande. Nkye ngye ayöb anki naa ubwaŋ abà bàmusiinà ngye u mbuul a mpem?
Unsà mpem bwoor angye, unsà mpem angye mpa ikwen musɔɔmà, ngye awàmubel nkyɛl a kölàköl akà ngye ŋakwo, ntɔn ilä a nkyɛl a Nzam, ilä usàmɛɛy nde ntsüül a nsaŋ ande yà balàbal,
nde asàfuur mbuur mbuur asànaa akyà isal ande:
mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye akà baar akwà, u mbwo a muküünà aba mukyer ubwaŋ anà muleŋ làkoo, ibyääl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ mpa afàtay,
wɛɛ nkyɛl anà mfuunà a mpem akà ba akwà, ntɔn mutɔn uwem, bàfàlwomà u mbwo a ndandaa anà bàfàlab mbwo ikɔ̈ɔ̈n balàbal.
Ngyɛb mbɔɔn anà bɔɔmà mbɔɔn byàsàkal ntɔn mbuur afàkyer ube, utàtwɛb akà Un'yudà, ungö akà Ungɛlɛki.
Wɛɛ làkoo, ibyääl anà duu byàsàkal akà mbuur wanswà afàkyer ubwaŋ, utàtwɛb akà Un'yudà, ungö akà Ungɛlɛki,
ntɔn akà Nzam un'kɔɔl aŋàyɔŋ watɛy.
Baar banswà bàkyer man'be ukɔɔn un'kɔɔn, bàsàkwà sye ukɔɔn un'kɔɔn. Baar banswà bàkyer man'be uboo a un'kɔɔn bàsatsüül nsaŋ u mbwo a un'kɔɔn.
La itàkal naa baar bàfàwem un'kɔɔn abà bàbalàbal kusà a Nzam, wɛɛ baar bàfàsyääl un'kɔɔn.
Isàkal naa baar mpa abà Ayudà, mpa bàyöb un'kɔɔn, abà bàfàkyer balàbal ndaa ufaswaŋ un'kɔɔn, un'kɔɔn awà amu ba ŋakwo, ba baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kɔɔn.
Ba ban'swaŋ naa isal ukweenà un'kɔɔn kyàŋàsɔn u mpem aba, an'kyän aba màmutà imbäl sye, ntsüül a nsaŋ u mpem aba taaŋ làmwɛy ikyer afapɛl, taaŋ lumwɛy ikyer afawɛɛl.
Ndaa ayin yanwsà isàmɛnà u mii a mii, umpal usàtsul Nzam nkääl a baar yàŋàyee u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ, asànaa awà ya unsà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ in'fàlɔŋ mɛ.
Ayudà anà un'kɔɔn
Wɛɛ, ngye mbuur bàfabel Un'yudà, afàsà mpem angye unsà un'kɔɔn anà afàswaŋ ngaal ntɔn Nzam angye,
ngye akyàyöb ukwen ande, un'kɔɔn ande kàkyàlɔŋ naa ufàsɔɔl aben ndaa a mfun, ntɔn wa bàkyalɔŋ,
ngye mbuur an'sà kam naa ngye afàsyen ikwàmii, ngye awà pɛɛlà a baar abà uboo a làpib,
un'lɔɔŋ insil anà wà baar mpa abye anà ngyööb, ntɔn ngye ngyööb anà ndandaa an'wal uboo a un'kɔɔn ...
Inye, ngye awɛy bää awà un'lɔɔŋ a baar asin, ntɔn nkye mpa alɔɔŋà ngye, ngye ŋakwo? Ngye afàlɔŋ naa bàkɔɔn ayib, ntɔn nkye ngye ŋakwo afàyib ngye?
Ngye afàtsuŋ baar mutà inswem, ntɔn nkye ngye ŋakwo afàtà ngye inswem? Ngye mbuur afàman itɛk ŋingyääy, wɛɛ ngye afàwal indiir a ngwal u ndwà a nzam aba!
Ngye afàswaŋ ngaal angye ntɔn un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ ngye afàbɛy Nzam utaaŋ afàdwa ngye un'kɔɔn!
Abun, ya yàŋàsɔn naa: « Ntɔn bɛ, ikɔb a Nzam kyàŋàbɛy akà in'sɛŋ asin. »
Ndandaa naa nkyɛɛy yà mfun isàkal naa ngye afàsyääl un'kɔɔn, wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye afàbɛy un'kɔɔn anà nkyɛɛy, ngye, ngye awà asànaa mbuur mpa awàŋàkyɛy.
Isàkal naa mbuur mpa awàŋàkyɛy afàlab in'kɔɔn, nkye Nzam ayun'kyey anki asànaa nde wàŋàkyɛy, itàkal naa nde kà wàŋàkyɛy anki?
Abun, mbuur mpa awàŋàkyɛy u ndür ande usilabà un'kɔɔn, nde asatsüül nsaŋ, ngye mbuur awe anà un'kaan a un'kɔɔn anà nkyɛɛy, wɛɛ ngye afàbɛy un'kɔɔn.
Ntɔn, kà ndaa ifàmɛnà u mii anki ifàkyer Un'yudà, itàkal idiim ifàmɛnà u ndür kyan'kyer nkyɛɛy,
wɛɛ ndaa aŋàyee ifàkyer Un'yudà, anà nkyɛɛy yà yà uboo a mpem, nkyɛɛy ifàfà amu Dweelà, kà kà un'kaan anki. Un'yudà a ndandaa awà, làkɔɔ ande afàwal anki akà baar, wɛɛ akà Nzam.
